description: BMW E46 M3 (S54) MSS54HP, CSL conversion tuning: from a DME image and a drive log, the VE (alpha-N) map the drive supports — which cells change and by how much, which need more driving and how. With out_path, also saves the tuned BIN (checksums corrected), byte-for-byte what MSS54HP CSL CONVERT /// TUNER's DOWNLOAD TUNED produces.

bin_path.description: Path to the 64 KB (65,536-byte) MSS54HP calibration partial ("0401 partial BIN") on this machine.

log_path.description: Path to a drive log CSV on this machine: a Testo MSS54 export, or a CSV TUNER exported.

out_path.description: Where to save the tuned BIN. Omit to get the values only.

use_sample.description: Use the bundled practice BIN and practice drive instead of files — to show what the tool does before the owner has files.

name: propose_ve
title: VE map correction from a drive
